title: HIBP Breach Count Change by Identity
dataSources: Breach alerts (`hibp:alert`), password age snapshots (`passwordage:account`), backup restore tests (`backuprestore:test`), and DNS leak checks (`dnsleak:check`).
app: Personal security telemetry from Have I Been Pwned, password-age exports, backup restore drills, and DNS leak checks sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hibp:alert
| bin _time span=1w
| stats max(total_breaches) as total_breaches min(total_breaches) as earliest_breaches by _time identity_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks breach count change over time and breaks it out by identity.
value: Change in breach count by identity shows whether one alias is accumulating far more exposure than the others.
implementation: Send breach count change events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of breach count change by identity.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how breach count change changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
